messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- Tomasz Nowak wrote the billing-api handover doc for Marcus on 2025-03-17. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- There is a deploy freeze on the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- On 2026-03-19, the Ember team noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- As of 2025-12-05, Diego Alvarez leaves Team Cinder and joins the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-05]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team noticed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year. [valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-12-01; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-03-19, the Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- Changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
